p: law of the leper in the: Or, the ceremony which shall be used in his purgation.
clean: Of birds which were permitted to be eaten.
running water: Running water, or of the fountains.
let the living bird loose into: Signifying that he that was made clean was set free, and restored to the company of others.
blemish: Which has no imperfection in any part.
and one log of oil: This quantity in Hebrew is called a Log, and holds six eggs in measure.
tenth deal of fine flour mingled: Which is an Omer, Ex 16:16.
wave them for a wave offering: Or, shall offer them as the offering that is shaken to and fro.
such as he can get: whether of them he can get.
law of him in whom is: This order is appointed for the poor man.
put the plague of leprosy in: This declares that no plague nor punishment comes to man without God's providence and his sending.
an unclean place: Where trash was cast, and other filth, that the people might not be infected by them.
break down the house: That is, he shall command it to be pulled down, as in Le 14:40.
scarlet: It seems that this was a lace or string to bind the hyssop to the wood, and so was made a sprinkle: the apostle to the Hebrews calls it scarlet wool, He 9:19.
